items.title: 68436_Alberta Hunter oral history interview
items.q: And a fellow named Leslie Hutchinson, who Bobby Short sounds exactly alike, played for me, never had a rehearsal or anything, played for me.

ctx.x: pay your own transportation and all your own expenses, and just mention the Lord Mayor's name at the border if you will do a benefit performance for the flood sufferers -- they had had a flood there -- for the flood sufferers.

Immediately I jumped to that. So I went from Monte Carlo to London to do this benefit, and while doing the benefit Sir Alfred Butt, Oscar Hammerstein and Jerome Kern were in the audience, and they heard me. And a fellow named Leslie Hutchinson, who Bobby Short sounds exactly alike, played for me, never had a rehearsal or anything, played for me.
Is he the one who used to write for the Chicago Defender, isn't it?
